research.name: auteur
research.note: Agent skill that fixes art direction before building a site, then gates the result with a linter for common AI design tells and a motion check.

effects: slopscan linter that fails a build on named AI design tells (purple-to-blue gradient, transition: all, default Inter, scroll listeners for animation)
commit-sheet that locks hue, type system and motion budget before any markup
motionqa Playwright gate measuring dropped frames at DPR 2 on a throttled CPU
landing page wordmark formed from a field of GPU particles

unverified: The live gallery was not seen running: the shared browser session showed another project's page, so demoViewed rests on README still screenshots (hero, FLUX, STATIC) and the fetched homepage HTML.
Cursor interaction (particles and fluid tearing and re-forming) and the 131,072 particle count come from README captions and on-page text; no motion was observed.
slopscan and motionqa were not executed; their behavior is taken from the README, and only the script files' presence in scripts/ was confirmed.
requiresHostedService is false per the README statement of no API keys and no dependencies; the skill still needs a coding agent to run, and optional asset generation uses external image CLIs.
